items.title: Blockchain.com Seeks Approval for US Prediction Markets and Crypto Derivatives
items.summary: The crypto platform filed for designated contract market and futures commission merchant licenses, which would let it run its own regulated event-contract venue instead of relying on overseas partners.

items.title: DWF Labs Subsidiaries Sue BitGo for $141 Million Over Early Token Sales
items.summary: The DWF Labs-linked firms allege in London’s High Court that BitGo sold discounted Falcon Finance and ESPORTS tokens roughly two months before their lock-up expired, cratering the value of their remaining holdings.

items.title: LiquidAcre Selects Uphold to Power Digital Asset Infrastructure and Future Tokenized Real Estate Offerings
items.summary: LiquidAcre, a financial technology company building a platform designed to expand access to real-world assets and digital financial services, has selected Uphold to power trading, custody, KYC, among other services to fulfill part of the infrastructure for tokenized real estate.
